name: Custom Shape 3-Layer Acrylic and Wood Standing
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic and wood, offering a durable, elegant, and eye-catching display finish.
    - Features a 3-layer construction that combines clear acrylic with wooden decorative elements for a dimensional and stylish appearance.
    - The acrylic layer has a thickness of 3mm and supports 2-sided printing for clear and vibrant personalized artwork.
    - The wooden decorative layers are made with a 3mm thickness and support 2-sided printing, adding warmth and character to the overall design.
    - The wooden base is made with a 5mm thickness, providing stable support for the tabletop display.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available size:
               +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
               +) 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Supports 2-sided printing on layer 1, layer 2, layer 3 and base.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized tabletop decoration and a meaningful keepsake display.
    - Designed to stand securely on desks, shelves, countertops, bedside tables, or office displays.
    - The layered structure helps create a visually appealing 3D effect that enhances the artwork.
    - Suitable for home décor, office decoration, celebration displays, award presentations, and personalized gift giving.
    - Perfect for adding a heartfelt and decorative touch to any personal space.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for dads, family members, friends, coworkers, teachers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, retirement gifts, appreciation gifts, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for custom awards, recognition gifts, memorial keepsakes, and decorative display pieces.
    - A thoughtful gift for anyone who enjoys personalized décor with sentimental value.
    - Great for desks, shelves, office spaces, and commemorative gift displays.
    - Adds a warm, elegant, and memorable touch to any occasion🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 3-Layer Acrylic and Wood Standing

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
